This video captures an impressive showcase of elite ball-handling skills by Golden State Warriors superstar Stephen Curry during an NBA basketball game against the Memphis Grizzlies. In the clip, Curry isolates Memphis defender Vince Williams Jr. on what is lightheartedly captioned as "Curry Island."  He puts on a dazzling display of dribbling mastery, putting the ball between his legs and behind his back, freezing the defender out on the perimeter with a mesmerizing rhythm. ​ As Curry drives toward the paint, he masterfully maneuvers around the defender, putting up a high-arching, underhanded floating layup that effortlessly drops through the net.  The momentum and speed of the play send Curry sliding flat onto his back on the floor beneath the basket. While resting on the hardwood, Curry celebrates his spectacular bucket with his iconic "shimmy" shoulder shake, while teammates rush over to help him up. ​ #StephCurry #Warriers #Handles #NBA #Basketball🔥
